findings.ac: nw worker ssh-command execs the four allowed subcommands and refuses everything else with exit 2, running nothing.
findings.title: own_nw() positive branch (argv[0] is an nw executable) is untested
findings.detail: test_own_nw_never_uses_the_client_path only covers the fallback to `python -m nightwright`. Nothing checks that a forced command started as /home/user/.local/bin/nw execs that path. The allowed-command tests patch own_nw out entirely.
findings.suggested_fix: In tests/test_worker_ssh_command.py, add a test that creates an executable file named `nw` in tmp_path, sets sys.argv to [str(that path)] and asserts W.own_nw() == [str(that path)].
findings.acceptance: uv run pytest -q tests/test_worker_ssh_command.py passes with the new test.

ac_assessment.ac: Piping a valid header and bundle into gate-job runs the gates and emits accepted, started, one gate frame per gate (with .log, .json and .r<n> files) and done
ac_assessment.evidence: worker.gate_job/_checkout/_run_gates/gate_files. test_pass_emits_frames_and_files asserts the exact frame sequence [accepted, started, gate, done], the file set and the frames.jsonl copy. test_retry_ladder_sends_r1_files asserts that the .r1.log and .r1.json files arrive.

ac_assessment.ac: git merge-base $NW_BASE HEAD on the worker prints the same sha as on the coordinator
ac_assessment.evidence: _checkout creates refs/heads/<name> (plus refs/remotes/origin/* when the name starts with origin/) in the private clone. test_merge_base_and_base_placeholder_match_the_coordinator compares the worker's output with `git merge-base main HEAD` run in the source repo, and also checks {base} and {spec_id}.

ac_assessment.ac: env key outside the allowlist gives an error frame with stage validate and nothing runs; a reused job_id gives stage claim
ac_assessment.evidence: validate_header checks the env allowlist. gate_job claims the job dir with an exclusive mkdir. test_env_outside_allowlist_is_refused asserts types == [error], stage validate, no marker file and no job dir. test_duplicate_job_id_is_a_claim_error asserts stage claim and an unchanged frames.jsonl.

ac_assessment.ac: Two concurrent jobs for one repo_key with different base.sha for the same base.name each see their own base
ac_assessment.evidence: Each job gets a `git clone --shared` with private refs. test_concurrent_jobs_see_their_own_base uses a filesystem barrier so the two gates overlap, and asserts rev-parse $NW_BASE == its own base both before and after the barrier.

ac_assessment.ac: EOF mid-gate ends the gate and emits done interrupted:true; EOF during the slot wait emits done interrupted:true and no started
ac_assessment.evidence: _watch_stdin sets cancel and calls G.terminate_all(). cancel is passed as stop= to gate_slots.acquire and run_gate_with_retries. test_eof_mid_gate_interrupts and test_eof_while_waiting_for_the_slot assert interrupted:true, rc 0, and no started or gate frame in the slot-wait case.

ac_assessment.ac: With the slot held by another process, the worker emits slot_wait, then started only once the slot frees
ac_assessment.evidence: Wired through gate_slots.acquire(wait_event_s=_slot_wait_event_s()). test_held_slot_gives_slot_wait_then_started holds the slot, asserts no started while it is held, then asserts the full sequence once it is released.

ac_assessment.ac: gate-job exits 0 after done (pass, fail or interrupted) and 3 after an error frame
ac_assessment.evidence: gate_job returns 0 after done, and _fail returns EXIT_ERROR=3. The tests assert rc for pass, fail (test_fail_is_done_with_ok_false_and_exit_0), the interrupted cases, and the validate, claim and checkout errors.

ac_assessment.ac: A log over 16 MiB arrives cut to 16 MiB with truncated_bytes in its sidecar
ac_assessment.evidence: _file_payload/gate_files keep the last MAX_LOG_BYTES and patch the sidecar. test_log_over_16_mib_is_truncated writes 17 MiB and asserts the length is exactly 16 MiB and truncated_bytes == n - 16 MiB.

ac_assessment.ac: have reports commit and base after the job; after gc --keep-days 0 have reports none, cat-file -e fails, job dirs are gone, a live job's dir survives
ac_assessment.evidence: _set_have, have() and gc() (live-job protection through the job.lock flock and live_shas, plus git gc --prune=now). test_have_then_gc_removes_refs_objects_and_job_dirs and test_gc_during_a_live_job_keeps_its_dir assert each of these points.

ac_assessment.ac: nw worker info --json prints the documented keys
ac_assessment.evidence: worker.info(). test_info_json_keys asserts the exact key set and the schema and protocol values.

ac_assessment.ac: ssh-command execs the four allowed subcommands and refuses everything else with exit 2, running nothing
ac_assessment.evidence: check_ssh_command uses a literal grammar, and own_nw() never uses the path the client sent. test_worker_ssh_command.py covers the 6 allowed forms (exec patched) and 24 refusals (metacharacters, empty, nw queue run, unknown options, --repo ../x), each asserting exit 2, no exec and a `refused:` stderr line.

ac_assessment.ac: docs/WORKFLOW.md documents the mandatory dedicated user and the absolute-path key line
ac_assessment.evidence: The new 'Remote gate worker' section includes the threat model, a mandatory dedicated unprivileged user, and the key line `command="/home/user/.local/bin/nw worker ssh-command",restrict ...`.
